name: code-block
title: Code Block
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Code Block: a 2px ink frame on paper, the file name in lettering above a fine rule, the code in mono, ink only (syntax colours are monochrome). Line numbers in ink. Line variants: highlighted (a 6px ink bar), added (bar and "+"), removed (accent bar, accent "−", struck text). Size sm, destructive frame. The copy button is an ink-framed square: hover thickens its line, focus draws the ink, click plays an impact, and the check icon shows once copied. Long lines scroll inside the block, never the page.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/code-block". It wraps your own components/ui/code-block, which is plain markup, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: A code frame in ink, with a copy square that stamps a check.
meta.usage:
import { CodeBlock, CodeBlockHeader, CodeBlockTitle, CodeBlockActions, CodeBlockCopyButton, CodeBlockContent, CodeBlockLine } from "@/components/ui/manga/code-block"

<CodeBlock>
  <CodeBlockHeader>
    <CodeBlockTitle>hero.tsx</CodeBlockTitle>
    <CodeBlockActions><CodeBlockCopyButton value={code} /></CodeBlockActions>
  </CodeBlockHeader>
  <CodeBlockContent lineNumbers>
    <CodeBlockLine variant="added">{"return <Button />"}</CodeBlockLine>
  </CodeBlockContent>
</CodeBlock>

props.name: variant
props.description: On CodeBlock: destructive draws the frame and the text in the accent.

props.name: size
props.description: On CodeBlock: smaller type and padding.

props.name: lineNumbers / startLine
props.description: On CodeBlockContent: number the lines in ink, from startLine.

props.name: wrap
props.description: On CodeBlockContent: wrap long lines instead of scrolling them.

props.name: variant
props.description: On CodeBlockLine: the bar and mark of the line.

props.name: value
props.description: On CodeBlockCopyButton: the text copied to the clipboard.
